items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: We had Walter Blenden and who else? We had a couple of them, white Gasper.

ctx.x: You see, we had Walter Blenden and who else? We had a couple of them, white Gasper. You see, well, his wife says, no, no. Then we got, who else?
Wait a minute. Hold up. Hold up. Hey, hey, hey, hey. I guess it's all right.
